profile.headline: Software Engineer at FINRA
profile.summary: Full stack developer with experience in all stages of the software lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and end-user support. I take particular pride and ownership in working with end-users to determine business needs, interface between business and technical communication, and ultimately deliver high-quality, robust, and intuitive products.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Full stack application design and development using Spring Boot and Angular, and utilizing AWS ECS, Lambda, Elasticsearch, RDS, DynamoDB
* Designed and implemented custom applications for enterprise delivery reporting and incident management, integrating with JIRA
* Active in all areas of the software lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and technical support with end-users

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Configured continuous integration pipelines to facilitate migration of apps from Amazon EC2 to Docker/ECS
• Developed initial codebase and several production features on a Spring Boot/Angular6 stack for an in-house app for management of AWS security groups.

positions.title: Data Engineering Intern
positions.description:
* Developed tools and services for the Zendesk enterprise Big Data ingestion and analysis platform.
* Created automated workflows for data ingestion and ETL into Google BigQuery using Airflow
* Built web application to programatically query and display data for financial reporting
* Designed and wrote tools for intuitive data import/export between Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery, and Jupyter data analysis notebooks

positions.title: Undergraduate Intern
positions.description:
* Built applications utilizing Amazon AWS services including S3, EC2, DynamoDB, Lambda, SNS
* Designed and implemented lightweight tools and services within a microservices architecture
* Created tools to simplify credentials management and backup/disaster-recovery processes
* Configured automated build/deployment procedures with Jenkins and AWS Cloudformation
* Used Java and REST APIs to automate and expedite workflow-based processes and services

positions.title: Lab Manager - Design | Cultures and Creativity
positions.description: Maintenance and rental of lab equipment
